channel.title: AI Daily Watch: Anthropic & Claude
channel.description: Claude models and apps, Claude Code, the Claude developer platform, partnerships, research and safety policy.

item.title: SoftwareOne achieves Select tier in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network
item.description: Anthropic: SoftwareOne announced that it achieved Select partner tier in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network Services Track. The announcement cites more than 100 certified experts and says SoftwareOne helps customers integrate, govern, and scale Claude deployments across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

item.title: Anthropic employee clarifies customer notice about unauthorized access to account information
item.description: Anthropic: An Anthropic employee clarified that a customer notice concerned Cathedral’s unauthorized access through third-party software used by Anthropic. The post says the accessed information included business contact and basic account details, but not prompts, outputs, or payment details, and that Anthropic contained affected systems and worked with vendors to close vulnerabilities.

item.title: Claude Duet adds mobile control for Claude Code sessions
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Duet added support for Claude Code sessions, letting users check what is running, approve changes, and send updates from a phone for sessions on a computer or in the cloud. Duet’s builder also said the update supports steering Claude Code Projects.

item.title: Anthropic publishes Project EVE tests of Claude in MMORPGs
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic reported Project EVE experiments in which Claude models traded in a simulated EVE Online market and teams of agents played EVE Frontier missions. The safety-relevant tests found that limited-access monitors detected only a minority of agents explicitly instructed to sabotage; Anthropic cautioned that this tested instructed behavior, not spontaneous inclination.

item.title: Anthropic describes “dreaming” as a way to organize agent memory
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic described agent-memory components for Claude, including notes, salience judgments, and “dreaming”: offline reflection that can correct mistakes and reorganize or create memories across sessions. The post explains how these methods may help agents retrieve useful experience without loading an unfiltered record of every past interaction.

item.title: Anthropic explores AI-assisted scientific modeling
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic’s Science Blog featured a guest post on AI-assisted scientific modeling, describing how AI can build, fit, and revise models to explore competing explanations of data. The authors emphasize that matching observed data is not by itself scientific understanding; examining alternative models and what the evidence supports matters.

item.title: Claude Code cloud sessions can configure and save repository environments
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic updated Claude Code cloud sessions on Pro, Max, and Ultra to help configure a repository’s environment: Claude determines needed dependencies, network access, and API keys, then saves the setup for future sessions. Anthropic says API keys are saved securely so Claude cannot see them.

item.title: Claude Enterprise adds beta project tags for tracking spend by cost code
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Enterprise added beta project tags so eligible organizations can track most project spend against existing codes, such as charge codes or client-matter numbers. This gives organizations another way to attribute and review usage costs without creating a new coding scheme.

item.title: Anthropic introduces Personal Finance in Claude
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic introduced Personal Finance in Claude, letting users connect selected financial accounts through Plaid and ask questions about balances, transactions, and spending. The feature is read-only, and Anthropic says conversations in its Personal Finance hub are not used to train its models.

item.title: METR estimates AI accelerated Anthropic’s model-capability progress
item.description: Anthropic: METR reported that Anthropic’s internal-model benchmark scores had grown at an estimated 1.9 times their prior rate since October 2025, roughly two years of historical progress in one year. METR attributed much of the acceleration to AI-assisted R&D but emphasized substantial uncertainty and possible contributions from other factors.

item.title: Anthropic adds security and admin controls to Claude Enterprise
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic announced Claude Enterprise security and admin updates, including a security center, centralized management, and access controls such as member sign-out through the Admin API and self-managed IP allowlisting. Inference hooks that check prompts and tool calls are generally available, while the security center and centralized management are in beta.

item.title: METR reviews Anthropic’s automated-R&D risk assessment
item.description: Anthropic: In a separate review of Anthropic’s August risk report, METR agreed that Anthropic’s internally deployed models posed low direct automated-R&D and acute acceleration risk as of July 15. However, METR said Anthropic’s public report understated the plausibility that acceleration was above its threshold, adding an independent safety-focused assessment alongside METR’s broader acceleration report.

item.title: Cat Wu joins OpenAI to lead Core Products product management
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI: Cat Wu announced that she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products, following her departure from Anthropic. This adds a concrete destination and role to the previously reported exit of a Claude Code product leader.

item.title: Claude Code reduces background subagent status-update usage
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Code now uses Haiku 5.5 to write background subagent status updates from short notes instead of rereading the full conversation, which Anthropic says makes each update cost about 99% less. Anthropic estimates sessions with background subagents use about 5% less of the usage limit overall; the change is available to most Pro, Max, and Ultra users and all Team and Enterprise users on v2.1.316 or later.

item.title: Anthropic adds partner agents and products to Claude Marketplace
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic added partner agents and products to Claude Marketplace in security, developer infrastructure, creative work, and productivity. Eligible enterprise customers can apply part of their committed Anthropic spend to the offerings, and the marketplace now has more than 25 partner agents and products.

item.title: Adobe's CX Enterprise Coworker becomes available in Claude
item.description: Adobe and Anthropic: Adobe announced that its CX Enterprise Coworker is now available within Claude, alongside other AI platforms, bringing customer-experience orchestration workflows into tools enterprises already use. Adobe also announced pre-built MCP connectors for integrating with partner systems.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.318 adds mod-consent records and sign-in expiry details
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Code v2.1.318 records users’ answers to prompts about enabling session-written mods and exposes stored sign-in expiry in `claude auth status` and `claude -p` JSON results, with warnings before expiry. It also adds `assume_role` support for certain Claude apps gateway AWS upstreams and an effort option for mod model forks.

item.title: Claude Code product lead Cat Wu announces her departure from Anthropic
item.description: Anthropic: Cat Wu announced that the previous Friday was her last day at Anthropic, where she led product for Claude Code. She thanked the teams and users and reflected on the product's growth; her post did not give a reason for leaving.

item.title: Claude adds auto-connect for plugins using Claude as a trusted issuer
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic announced a beta that lets compatible MCP-server plugins auto-connect when users log in to Claude, reducing repeated sign-in and authorization steps. ClaudeDevs says the feature is in beta for Team and Enterprise plans.

item.title: Anthropic adds text watermarking for Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, and Sonnet 4.6
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic's November 3 platform notes say text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, and Sonnet 4.6 carries its text watermark on supported platforms. The notes caution that Sonnet 4.6 outputs may not carry the watermark when temperature, top_p, or top_k is set to a non-default value.

item.title: Anthropic opens Messages API message threads beta to speed up long-running agents
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic launched message threads in public beta for the Messages API: after the initial conversation, developers can send only new messages rather than resending the full history. Anthropic says requests of 500,000 to 1 million tokens see about 35% lower median time to first token; the beta is available on Claude Platform, AWS, Microsoft Foundry, and Anthropic-managed Claude on Google Cloud.

item.title: Anthropic releases FlashProve, an open-source prototype for provable inference
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic published research on FlashProve, an open-source prototype for cryptographically verifying model inference while keeping model weights hidden. It released code, Lean formalization, and protocol documentation; the work advances inference verification research, though Anthropic identifies it as an intermediate prototype with technical limitations.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.316 adds subagent and gateway controls and deprecates Opus 4.8 fast mode
item.description: Anthropic: Claude Code 2.1.316 adds configurable subagent effort, an option to disable the “ultrathink” keyword, and pooled group budgets and policy controls for the Claude apps gateway. It also deprecates Opus 4.8 fast mode as of October 30, with removal scheduled for November 30, 2026.

item.title: Claude renames its Max plans and removes the five-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic renamed Max 5x to Max and Max 20x to Ultra without changing their $100 and $200 monthly prices. Verified Ultra accounts no longer have a five-hour usage limit, while weekly limits remain; the plans also include monthly Claude Platform API credits.

item.title: Anthropic describes Claude’s self-assessment system for flagging potential misuse
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic publicly described Claude’s “self-assessment” mechanism, which produces a preliminary safety assessment after a response and can flag potential misuse. The company said it had used the technique since June and that it had surfaced misuse not caught by other safeguards; it is described as one safety signal, not as a replacement for broader safeguards.

item.title: Claude API request-size limit increases from 32 MB to 128 MB
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic increased the first-party Claude API’s maximum request size for Messages and Token Counting from 32 MB to 128 MB, giving image-heavy requests such as large PDFs and computer-use sessions more headroom. For requests with more than 20 images, it also raised the per-image limit from 2,000 to 3,000 pixels; cloud-hosted platforms have separate limits.

item.title: Claude announces mobile-app upgrades, multi-account switching, and 24 additional languages
item.description: Anthropic: Claude announced several app improvements, including a side-by-side/full-screen experience on iPad and iPhone Duo, multiple-account switching on iOS and Android, and laptop-style Android support on Chromebooks and foldables. Claude also added 24 languages across web, desktop, iOS, and Android, bringing the total to 33.

item.title: SentinelOne plans to add Claude Mythos 5.1 to its Wayfinder security service
item.description: Anthropic: SentinelOne announced plans to add Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5.1 to Wayfinder Frontier AI Services, where it will be used alongside security experts to help identify and assess software risks. The announcement is a new security-services partnership development; SentinelOne described the addition as upcoming rather than already available.

item.title: Anthropic expands AI for Science support to foundations and research institutions
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic expanded its AI for Science program beyond individual researchers, partnering with 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups and providing Claude credits for research. The announcement also highlights collaborations on safe lab-instrument use and AI-assisted analysis of scientific datasets, broadening the program’s institutional reach.

item.title: IDC brings its Quanta research platform into Claude and adopts Claude company-wide
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic and IDC brought IDC Quanta into Claude, letting IDC customers query the research platform’s forecasts, market data, and analysis through Claude. IDC also rolled Claude out across its own business, combining a customer-facing research integration with a significant enterprise adoption.

item.title: Anthropic makes smart reports, surveys, and pooled budgets generally available for Claude Enterprise
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic made smart reports, in-app surveys, and pooled group budgets generally available for Claude Enterprise. The features give organizations new ways to understand Claude usage and outcomes, gather employee feedback, and set shared team spending limits.

item.title: Anthropic adds ready-to-use legal artifacts to Claude for Legal
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic added a gallery of ready-to-use interactive artifacts for Claude for Legal, including tools for contract review, regulatory tracking, and routing legal requests. Legal teams can adapt and share the tools using their own data and connectors, extending Claude Enterprise’s workflow options for legal work.

item.title: Anthropic reports Claude-assisted vulnerability discoveries in widely used software
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that an internal research model helped identify serious vulnerabilities across widely used software. Anthropic says the findings were reported to affected vendors, and that 62 Google-assigned CVEs had been patched as of Chrome 156; the report highlights the growing relevance of AI-assisted defensive security research.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.312 adds gateway identity-claim support and improvements
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.312, adding an OIDC user-ID claim setting for the Claude apps gateway, including support for claims such as Microsoft Entra ID’s `oid`. The release also includes usability, settings, and reliability fixes across Claude Code, VS Code, and cloud sessions.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude for Financial Advisors with partner connectors
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic updated Claude for Financial Advisors with additional partner integrations and workflow skills for advisors. One announced addition brings J.P. Morgan Asset Management subsidiary 55ip’s tax-aware portfolio technology into Claude through a new connector.

item.title: Anthropic shares early Claude-assisted drug-development progress
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic reported early results from Claude-related work with six life-sciences organizations: BigHat Biosciences, Bristol Myers Squibb, Divergence Labs, Enveda, Generate Biomedicines, and The Column Group. It also described in-house drug-discovery efforts, including programs focused on rare forms of muscular dystrophy, illustrating an expansion of Claude’s use into biomedical research.

item.title: Anthropic releases Claude for Nonprofits plugin
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic released a Claude for Nonprofits plugin, built with about 30 nonprofit organizations, with skills and connectors for fundraising, marketing, hiring, and related operational work. It is included at no additional cost for nonprofits on Team and Enterprise plans; Anthropic also plans to extend its Claude Corps program through a Taproot partnership.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.311 adds self-hosted runner controls and reliability fixes
item.description: Anthropic: Anthropic published Claude Code v2.1.311 with new `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` controls for self-hosted runners, alongside fixes spanning startup freezes, context handling, MCP tools, and background sessions. The release also changes `ultrathink` to run at xhigh effort on specified Claude models through Anthropic’s API.

item.title: Claude Code contributor Thariq says he has left Anthropic
item.description: Anthropic: Thariq publicly said he had left Anthropic after more than a year working on Claude Code. His post thanked colleagues and the Claude Code community; it is notable personnel news related to Claude Code, though it does not announce a product change.
